test_title: PYST 74: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 24 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'IFF' is coded as '21' and 'ARB' is coded as '21'. How will 'CAW' be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'IFF' is coded as '21'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f2093bdbb4664a39781122706906606daa193891762d1edbb6b949050e1632d5.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6883329ebd7d00aeddf01af85106577c6cfa722944213fa830edd8dbdb94969.png] 

'ARB' is coded as '21'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6f31ff0debcc6ad11cf4910dfff2aa56915a39f1d53d10705cb95d5fad63973.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e30845f5bbb426d8f5721cf3e55763c16cabcfd528332b60a4fc2fe8cd4447d9.png] 

Similarly, '**CAW**' will be coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e309adc7d7aa062b6a8d156e2a09a6a48166a83e93c6ac890d0209beaeccc887.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d943f0cbca57e5d495e337cc4605e5eafd888d273f240531edbc066093e96d2.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "27".
